claims.evidence: Screen lit in both photos confirms power-on only; no footage of keys, buttons, or sound output.
Photo 0 shows yellowing/discoloration on white keys, especially right side, indicating wear or sun exposure.
Seller's stated motive; no photographic or documentary evidence possible.
No video or audio demonstration of each key/button response.
No adapter visible in either photo; not shown separately.
No import documentation, UK plug, or packaging visible.
Requires audio/video proof of sound and key response, not present in static photos.

risks.risk: Exact model unknown, affecting base price tier
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model label/serial plate on the back or underside.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest plausible Yamaha keyboard tier for a visually similar unit.

risks.risk: Unconfirmed full key and button functionality
risks.proof: Video panning across all keys being pressed and all buttons/sliders being operated.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if some keys/buttons may be faulty (worst case partial function).

risks.proof: Short audio/video clip of the keyboard playing a tone or demo song through its speakers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if speaker may be damaged or crackling.

risks.proof: Photo of the actual power adapter next to the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unit without adapter (buyer must source one).

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic/structural damage not visible from these two angles
risks.proof: Additional photos of the back, underside, and close-ups of each corner/edge.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn with possible undisclosed damage.

risks.risk: Yellowing may indicate significant age or heat/sun exposure affecting plastic integrity
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit close-up of the keys showing extent of discoloration.
risks.if_unproven: Price as visibly aged unit, lower cosmetic grade.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model/serial number label.
Video demonstrating every key and button functioning, including sound.
Photo of the included power adapter alongside the unit.
Additional photos of the back, underside, and edges for hidden damage.
Clear daylight photo of the keys to assess yellowing extent.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Yamaha electronic keyboard, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified functional claims and visible cosmetic wear, pending further proof to raise the price.
